dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the lateral margins starting from the mid-section and progressing toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance across the primary dorsal surface with minimal shadow-casting.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency; very faint, diffuse grey patches are visible around the melon region and along the distal lateral margins.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; graduate gradients between the white baseline and faint greyish pigmented zones.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: High-contrast dark circular aperture at the blowhole; a series of dark, intermittent point-marks along a longitudinal posterior axis.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear longitudinal indentation following the central dorsal ridge in the posterior half of the visible body.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, dark-pigmented longitudinal linear mark or scar running along the dorsal ridge, exhibiting segmented high-contrast spots.
